influences.name: King Krule's uncle
influences.context: My surroundings, my family have all had an influence. There are a bunch of musicians in the family. My uncle was in a band that played rocksteady and ska, and I used to go see them a lot.

influences.name: Mount Kimbie
influences.context: Mount Kimbie have a really fucking good sound, man!

influences.name: King Creole
influences.context: His moniker, King Krule, is inspired by the 1958 movie musical King Creole

influences.name: Mike Lee
influences.context: I was quite young when I started to write all this stuff that was socially real, talking about walking down the street, and Easy Easy was a song I wrote when I was very much into Mike Lee, Ken Loach and Shane Meadows, people like that.
